items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-8,800 (levels 1-15). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Power Surge T3, Storm Cloud T1. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Cultist Sacrifice. Ultimate (Storm Cloud) is available from Cultist Sacrifice.

items.name: Monster Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 6,400 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 6400 souls (~6.4 min), 6 purchases

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 5,600 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 5600 souls (~5.6 min), 5 purchases

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 4,800 souls on. Upgrade of High-Velocity Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 4800 souls (~4.8 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Surge of Power, 8000 souls (~8.0 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 3,200 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Swift Striker
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Cultist Sacrifice completes 2,400 souls on. Upgrade of Rapid Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Cultist Sacrifice completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Cultist Sacrifice
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (4,000 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 18 to 54% weapon damage. Upgrade of Monster Rounds (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Imbued on Power Surge: its duration-scaled parts (duration 20s, damage per chain 18s) get +22%.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,800-24,000 (levels 15-27). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Lightning Ball T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Static Charge, damage) grows from 72.5 to 123. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Surge of Power.

items.name: Surge of Power
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Power Surge: +28 spirit on that ability only, about +15.4 on its bonus per chain (0.55x scaling). Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Unstoppable, 27200 souls (~27.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Unstoppable, 26400 souls (~26.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Unstoppable, 25600 souls (~25.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 14.3 to Static Charge's damage (0.79x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Tesla Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 6,400 to 9,600 invested: bonus 54 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Toxic Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 9,600 to 12,800 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,000-44,800 (levels 27-34). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Static Charge T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Static Charge, damage) grows from 123 to 327. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Unstoppable.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k, 8k tiers): bonus 12 to 46 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Pop it before you ult so nobody cancels the storm.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 23.8 to Static Charge's damage (0.79x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Takes spirit from 12,800 to 17,600 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Enduring Speed? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Opening Rounds.
sections.desc: Dying after Enduring Speed? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Opening Rounds.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: They hit you with Knockdown, Slowing Hex or Toxic Bullets.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Infernus, Kelvin, Geist, Vyper.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Storm Cloud channel time (14s), Power Surge duration (20s), Power Surge damage per chain (18s). Same-slot upgrade of Duration Extender for 1,600 more souls: bullet resist 0 to 8..

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Ricochet
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 19,200 to 22,400 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.caption: Storm Cloud deals damage (damage per second, lightning strike damage), so it applies the item's 0.75s stun after a 3s delay plus 150 damage. Takes spirit from 17,600 to 24,000 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. Replaces Cultist Sacrifice: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Enduring Speed for 4,800 more souls: fire rate slow 0 to 40; slow resistance percent 25 to 50..
